name: 06_overlap_at_playback_start
description: Adversarial (scripted): (a) the caller starts 'Wait, wrong order' 150 ms after the answer starts; (b) on the next question the caller starts talking the moment the reply is ready, before its first audio. Both must resolve to one barge-in or one merge, never two answers in parallel.
